sources.title: Tuza's conjecture for graphs of maximum degree at most seven
sources.extracted_claim: There exists a finite simple graph of maximum degree at most 3 with triangle edge-cover number equal to twice its edge-disjoint triangle packing number.

sources.title: Quantum Energy Levels and Riemann Zeros
sources.extracted_claim: Assuming Im(E_rho)=t(1-2 sigma) for rho=sigma+it with t nonzero, E_rho is real exactly when sigma=1/2.
